gate: reference pixels (model parity): per forced row cosine >= 0.995 against the float32 upstream reference, argmax equal unless a near-tie (reference top-1 minus top-2 probability < 0.1, native token in the reference top-5), greedy identical up to the reference end (its final stop token excluded) or first diverging at such a near-tie. Kit preprocessing on the same decode (end to end): grid equal, pixel cosine >= 0.9999 against the reference processor (resampler only), then the model-parity rule. Kit preprocessing on an independent decode (decoder sanity): grid equal and pixel cosine >= 0.999 against the reference processor; logits and tokens reported (logitsWithinDecoderBand: forced rows cosine >= 0.98 on every case)
hostLoad: Shared host; timings are single observations
